The blasts lifted millions of tons of dust, soot and radioactive particles into the atmosphere. A nuclear winter set in: the sun is hidden for years, temperatures drop by fifteen degrees, crops die. Water, soil and air are contaminated with radiation. People are dying of radiation sickness and hunger.
Из лаборатории вырвался модифицированный: A modified virus with a forty percent fatality rate escaped from a laboratory. It spreads through the air. The incubation period lasts three days. The symptoms resemble a common cold, so the disease spread across the world within weeks. There is no vaccine and no cure. Hospitals are overwhelmed, and doctors die first. Quarantines do not work. Mass graves are dug, crematoriums cannot keep up. Transport has stopped and riots have begun.
Астероид диаметром два километра упал в: An asteroid two kilometers wide fell into the ocean. A tsunami more than a hundred meters high rose up. The shock wave circled the planet several times. Dust and water were thrown into the stratosphere. Coastal regions were washed away in minutes. A dust winter lasting four years has begun. Sunlight is weakened by eighty percent. Agriculture is destroyed, temperatures are falling, and a terrible famine is starting.
Проснулся супервулкан. Извержение выброс: A supervolcano has awakened. The eruption threw thousands of cubic kilometers of ash and sulfur into the atmosphere. Within hundreds of kilometers everything is buried under up to a meter of ash. The ash blocks the sun for three years. A volcanic winter is coming. Roofs collapse under the weight of ash. The water is poisoned by sulfur. Breathing without a respirator is deadly. Agriculture is destroyed, livestock is dying, and transport is paralyzed.

Cholera, typhoid and malaria spread in the standing water. Infrastructure is ruined and communication is lost.
